correctness.rationale: For every existing symmetric 2-(v,k,lambda) design, 2<=lambda<=k-2, the incidence M satisfies MM^T=(k-lambda)I+lambda J and M^TM the same. Connected bipartite graph Laplacian gives explicit dipole potentials for any incidence edge, with seven edge classes of fixed sizes and current signs. Summing magnitudes gives ||Q||_1=||Q||_infty=1+2(k-1)A/(k lambda v). The diagonal effective resistance is R=(2k(k-1)+lambda)/(k lambda v) in (0,1), so P=I-Q has norm ||Q||+1-2R; difference=(k(k-1)(k-4)+(k-2)lambda)/(k lambda v)>0. Exact symbolic seven-class sums were recomputed; independent biplane rational grounded-Laplacian inversion reproduced all 55 columns. Conditional existence and real unit edge norms only.
